reviews.text: This is the second time I have taken my dog here and she does great work.  Every time I pick up my dog he is very happy and looks great.  I would highly recommend going here!!
Reyna is amazing. She has done a great job for my shih tzu mix for 6 years, monthly. My dog loves when I say, “Let’s go see Reyna” she runs to the door to leave. My pup is well groomed and happy.
This is the spot i go to for my babies. They're  professional and always fo a good job. Love coming here for my boys

I like that it is a nice quiet, grooming shop. There are not a bunch of other dogs so I feel like it is a calmer experience for my dog. The price is good and I really like that you can schedule online.

Le Doggie is awesome. They always do a great job with my corgi. (See pictures - hot dog costume is before a recent grooming.) It can be hard to find a groomer who knows not to cut corgis’ undercoats, which can hurt their ability to regulate their body temperature. I feel good knowing my dog is in skillful and knowledgeable hands at Le Doggie. The workers are also very patient with her, even though she can be a diva and bark a lot. They even gave her a cute bandana last time. I highly recommend Le Doggie, especially to people who own corgis or other high-maintenance dogs.
They always do a great job and are kind and caring with my senior dog and my crazy young guy. 💛 …

Reyna is a kind-hearted and gentle groomer who does her work with love.
Thank you Le Doggie Pet Grooming, you are excellent!
Nice clean place. They did a pretty good job with my labradoodle.
We always bring our dogs here. Such great service!

This is the ONLY place we take our Pomeranian. He’s very nervous and we’ve had some not so great experiences at other groomers in the past. This is the absolute best groomer we’ve ever found. The cut is exactly what we ask for, he never leaves looking stressed or anxious and we love supporting this small business. The picture included us right after his haircut still in the parking lot. Alfredo approved!!
Best dog groomer in the valley. Love this place! They are so nice and my dogs love it there.

Reyna is the best, most talented, kind, professional and very reasonably priced groomer we have ever had for our pups. She always makes our pups look and smell delicious and the salon is the most beautiful, immaculate and wonderfully smelling salon that we have ever experienced. We're beyond appreciative that a neighbor through Nextdoor recommended her...thank you, thank you, thank you for this little hidden gem!
Didn't have appointment but still took me in. Gave my dog a bath. Very nice and helpful.
